_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The analyst's reasoning suggests a shift towards institutional conviction, which aligns with the upward movement from Hope to Belief.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes, both experts agree on the next phase.
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed index rises above 80 and BTC 30d momentum > +30%
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 25 and stablecoin_growth rebounds > +15%
